scope: Read-only interface review of existing code and historical materials. No new-date RT/actual values or policy outcomes opened; no experiments run.
recommendation: Use one small stage-specific preparation/runner layer; retain the existing V41 physical model, repaired frozen emission candidate, public-clock rules, menu construction rules and all eight fixed controls. A new date panel alone is not algorithmic novelty.

interfaces.use: Source-version-correct isolated static runtime; retain original16 stations, SBB named trains, service activation, physical sequence adjacency,07:30–09:35 graph window and full platform IDs. Construct release groups sequentially or in separate processes because dated_connections_from_static temporarily changes the builder module ROOT.

Join service day/operator/train/station/kind/planned-minute; REAL, CANCELED, PROGNOSE, ambiguity and missing remain distinct. Call with empty rows before target access to create schedule-only placeholders; later attach filtered server actuals without changing connection order/IDs.

Freeze all date mappings before RT decode. Build full-day public endpoint catalogs via training_identity_v1/public_catalog.py. Match exact public identity, retain unknowns, no literal-ID fallback. For a graph built from its correct source release the public mapping should normally be identity; do not reuse Oct24 graph merely to reuse IDs.

Existing local or server archive path accepted; original V34 10-minute capture phase and07:00–09:40 window, receipt=max(capture,header,TripUpdate), source CIDs and canonical trip IDs. Reuse from server without copying national tar locally. decision_calibration_v2/fetch_messages.py separately supports raw published-platform evidence if required; model does not consume platform audit fields.

Schedule-only roots from frozen topology recipe; context returns graph/world/stop mapping/source-to-local mapping/metadata/omitted connections. Explicitly keep the existing station-transfer bounds for the frozen model, and audit new source-platform evidence separately.

select_public freezes the public cohort using deterministic direct/shared/two-transfer layers with original daily cap. initial_state uses the unchanged physical executor to establish whether the first decision is actually reached; complete endpoints alone do not imply a reached root.

Build wide menu and public upstream-prefix closure before labels. Save cap/candidate ledgers and freshly measured construction cost. ObservationContract.from_menu(expanded) and original-union rule preserve common station observations. Audit all expanded path endpoints plus observation-only departure slots after menu freeze.

Pure arm execution can reuse repaired fit snapshot, setup(), PhysicalHistory, MatchedContinuationPlanner and PolicyExecutor. New runner supplies new data/messages/menus and its own frozen root manifest, rotated arm order and128-world/120-CPU original budget. Update output menu_source/menu_cost_source metadata; do not claim a new menu paid the old V50 construction cost.

required_integration_changes: Do not invoke old main programs unchanged: V34 build_sources/messages bind old date lists; control_identity check_inputs binds72 roots and old selection; initialize/run_root bind V34 data and decision_gap menus. Their low-level functions accept new dated contexts, but entrypoints are historical cohort scripts.

Do not use V34.select as an expanded-menu completeness guarantee: it calls label_coverage and message_eligibility on the original narrow root. Freeze the expanded menu first, run endpoint_coverage on the expanded node plus common observation contract, and audit predecision numeric publication timing against expanded nonincoming tail endpoints. Keep the complete public root/exclusion ledger; do not select by forecast value, loss or policy advantage.

For a natural decision require an observed initial prefix and a numeric future-tail message with receipt no later than the first reached decision. Preserve no-message, missing-endpoint, canceled-prefix, clock-failure and unsupported-history roots as explicit outcomes, not replacement candidates.
Keep newly encountered route IDs on the existing pooled-prior/emission fallback and report those counts. Do not refit the physical model or repaired emission candidate to the new panel.
bugs_assessed: No new solver/model defect established by this read-only review. The obsolete hard-coded cohort entrypoints and narrow-menu eligibility are confirmed integration hazards if copied unchanged; use the existing generic functions and full-menu audit rather than changing frozen solver semantics.
data_and_interpretation_boundaries: Existing archive filenames or old confirmation labels do not imply untouched dates; use the exposure inventory and metadata-only date freeze before reading values.

Partial actual archive prefixes cannot establish full endpoint coverage. Use cached full-member filtered rows where available; retain unknown labels and original bounded loss rather than fabricate cancellations or drop roots.

RT capture filename is collector time, not verified operator delivery. Preserve the frozen phase filter; a present archive can yield zero sampled morning snapshots. Empty/missing frames are not vehicle nonoccurrence.

Choose static release from public collector validity metadata (next ZIP mtime calendar day14:00), not directory date or best RT match. Calendar validity alone is insufficient publication-version provenance.

Fixed station-max MCT with fallback120 and ideal boarding clock remain the replay semantics. Public station-only stop IDs or scheduled platforms do not establish realized platform-specific transfer time.

The root generator retains the existing16-station/window, route-service count, waiting-window, ride-depth and path caps. dated_graph omits no-dropoff connections. Report this declared finite graph/menu scope; do not interpret an empty candidate set as a network-wide negative result or silently expand scope.

All cheap policies remain separate deployed comparators. A per-root hindsight best cheap score may describe coverage but is not an online controller. Keep all positive,negative,tie,missing and CPU-unfinished cases; same-state finite128-world banks are not population-optimality certificates.
